svg.title: northern development 2020 stacked
svg.desc: Original source vector extraction. Source: https://www.northerndevelopment.bc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/NDIT2020AR_Final_Web.pdf; PDF page 1; crop in page points [420, 60, 554, 153]. Native PDF paths and shadings converted with Poppler pdftocairo. Gradient shadings retained as SVG linearGradient elements; no bitmap approximation.
